historical_cache_preparation.metric: Cached biharmonic Cholesky resolvent; replaced by production stable metric at training load

current_metric_probe.scope: Three existing unlabeled inputs, three production stable-metric builds each; one CPU process with thread limits while GPU training continues. No mesh generation, serialization, transfer or full producer pipeline benchmark.

estimated_input_only_online_producer.assumptions: Mesh/assembly means from historical512input six-worker run plus new three-geometry stable-metric mean; replace old metric rather than adding it; no compressed disk writes; idealized worker scaling; excludes interprocess copies, padding, host/device transfer, startup and contention. NOT an end-to-end online benchmark.

proposal: After current fixed50k completes, assess asynchronous input-only generation into a bounded refreshed pool with sample reuse and fixed padded shapes/dtypes. No sampler, architecture, prior, physics, optimizer, run or default changed.
limitations: Nine timed metric builds cover three existing geometries only.
Unbounded sampling support needs an explicit checked padding envelope; observed1024bank maxima are not a proof of a global bound.
Same reserved development references can monitor L2; newly generated training geometries need no future labels.
Larger network plus larger/online bank may improve generalization but is not yet an observed combination.
